easy_fields.name: SCIENCEQA
easy_fields.creator: Pan Lu, Swaroop Mishra, Tony Xia, Liang Qiu, Kai-Wei Chang, Song-Chun Zhu, Oyvind Tafjord, Peter Clark, Ashwin Kalyan
easy_fields.citeAs: Lu, P., Mishra, S., Xia, T., Qiu, L., Chang, K.-W., Zhu, S.-C., Tafjord, O., Clark, P., & Kalyan, A. (2022). Learn to Explain: Multimodal Reasoning via Thought Chains for Science Question Answering. 36th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2022).
easy_fields.description: SCIENCEQA is a new benchmark dataset consisting of 21,208 multimodal multiple-choice science questions with diverse topics. It includes annotations of answers with corresponding lectures and explanations, covering natural science, social science, and language science from elementary to high school curricula.

G3_collection.reasoning: The paper details the data collection methodology in Section A.1, including sourcing from IXL Learning, extraction of components, and manual removal of invalid or duplicated questions.

sections: B.3 Human Evaluation of Generated Explanations
G4_annotation.reasoning: The paper describes that initial annotations were extracted using heuristic rules and manually revised by experts, and also details human evaluation protocols for model-generated explanations, including annotator qualifications and quality control.

G5_rai.reasoning: The paper includes an error analysis and a dedicated 'Broader Impacts' section discussing societal impact, the absence of personal/sensitive information, and intended use cases.

G6_processing.reasoning: The paper describes preprocessing steps such as removing invalid questions, shuffling options, and reformatting texts, and mentions the data splits and the public release of the dataset.
